prior_archive_policy: Prior raw tree, reports and published archive preserved. Reads used read only database connections; no prior bytes were edited.

probe_policy.network_scope: Six ordinary publisher RSS snapshots and two legacy DoorDash publishing endpoints.
probe_policy.notes: Initial three probes used a descriptive research identifier. Remaining probes used the published crawler identifier. Exact identifiers and timing are retained per receipt. No identity was varied in reaction to a blocked response.

web_access_probe.classification: access probe, previously read source excluded from recovery and deliberate read gains
web_access_probe.limit: Tool extracted text includes site navigation and may omit source content. Not a direct HTML transport receipt.

limits: Legacy homepage redirects to the current careers Engineering landing page, not a separate historical archive.
Legacy feed returns HTTP 403. No challenge bypass, query variant, session forgery or retry loop was used.
One ordinary web retrieval repeated a previously read article while testing access. It is retained as a probe and excluded from recovery and read gains.

verification: Verified prior publisher report to raw summary digest bindings for all three publishers.
Verified every response, encoded body and extracted text digest against stored bytes.
Deduplicated normalized scoped article URLs across category feeds.
Excluded previously retrieved full response overlaps from recovery gains.
Kept short substantive feed content distinct from automatic extraction.
No revised instruction candidate or behavioral evaluation was part of this continuation.
limits: RSS snapshots expose no archive pagination; feed exhaustion is not historical archive exhaustion.
No newly discovered article locator in these snapshots proves the absence of omitted historical URLs.
Body retrieval and automatic extraction remain separate from deliberate reading.
Ten Airbnb current site matches are title alias candidates, not independently observed rel canonical identities.
Remaining source access and missing historical archive boundaries are unresolved.
Remaining gap counts do not mean every ordinary source was exhausted. Additional scoped tag and category feed candidates remain unprobed in this bounded continuation.

unprobed_ordinary_source_candidates.source: Publication tag feeds for engineering, technology, machine-learning and data-science
unprobed_ordinary_source_candidates.basis: Tag names exist in the retained first party article category metadata. Other tag snapshots were outside this bounded continuation.

unprobed_ordinary_source_candidates.source: RSS routes for remaining official security, machine-learning, mobile and frontend categories
unprobed_ordinary_source_candidates.basis: Category names exist in the official archive. Category/feed routes are a proposed ordinary publishing probe, not yet verified endpoints.
